verdict.rationale: The evidence shows real-time tracking of latency, cost, and quality, plus dashboards and the ability to 'configure monitoring' from MCP clients. Nothing documents threshold-based alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops, or delivery to Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Monitoring dashboards and online scoring are adjacent features, not alerting with notification routing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
